from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document that support classification into the 6 administrative causes."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 3》')")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The fundamental nature of the case, e.g., 'Civil', 'Administrative'")
    administrative_act: str | None = Field(description="The specific administrative act or decision under review, e.g., 'Work Injury Recognition', 'Company Registration', 'Land Compensation', 'Lawyer Punishment'")
    administrative_body: str | None = Field(description="The administrative body that made the act, e.g., 'Human Resources and Social Security Bureau', 'Justice Bureau', 'Environmental Protection Bureau'")
    key_dispute_focus: str | None = Field(description="The core legal dispute or subject matter, e.g., 'Whether injury is work-related', 'Validity of company registration'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
